name: Semco 2K Primer
tdsContent:
Semco 2K Primer is a two-component epoxy-based primer designed for use on concrete, plywood, cement board, and existing tile substrates. It provides excellent adhesion for all Semco microcement systems.

Mixing Ratio: Component A (base) to Component B (hardener) = 3:1 by volume. Mix thoroughly for 3 minutes using a low-speed mixer (300–400 rpm).

Application: Apply with a short-nap roller (6mm) or brush. Apply one coat evenly. Allow to become tacky (approximately 1–2 hours at 20°C) before applying the first base coat. Do not allow primer to fully cure before applying microcement.

Coverage: 8–10 m² per kg on smooth surfaces. Porous substrates may require a second coat.

Pot Life: 45 minutes at 20°C. Discard mixed product after pot life has expired.

Full cure: 4 hours at 20°C before base coat application. Full chemical cure: 7 days.

Temperature: Apply and cure at 10°C–30°C. Do not apply in direct sunlight or on heated floors above 25°C.

Cleaning: Clean tools immediately with acetone before product hardens.

Safety: Contains epoxy resin and polyamine hardener. Wear appropriate PPE: nitrile gloves, safety glasses. Ensure adequate ventilation.

name: Semco Adhesion Primer
tdsContent:
Semco Adhesion Primer is a single-component water-based acrylic primer for use on drywall (gypsum board), existing painted surfaces, and non-structural interior walls. Not suitable for floor applications or heated surfaces.

Application: Apply one coat with a short-nap roller or brush. Allow to dry completely (2 hours at 20°C) before applying the base coat.

Coverage: 10–14 m² per litre on smooth surfaces. One coat is typically sufficient.

Cure: Dry to touch in 1 hour. Ready for overcoating in 2 hours at 20°C, 50% relative humidity.

Temperature: 10°C–28°C. Do not apply in humid conditions above 75% RH.

Note: For substrates with previous coatings, perform crosshatch adhesion test before application. Remove any loose or flaking existing coatings.

name: Semco Microcement Base — Fine (W Series)
tdsContent:
Semco Microcement Base W Series is a cement-based, polymer-modified coating for the base layer of interior microcement systems. It is pre-mixed with quartz aggregate (fine grade, 0–300μm) and requires only water addition.

Mixing: Add powder to clean water (not the reverse). Water ratio: 28–30% by weight (approximately 7–7.5 litres per 25 kg bag). Mix for 3 minutes with a low-speed mixer (300–400 rpm) until smooth and lump-free. Allow to rest 2 minutes, then briefly re-mix.

Application: Apply with a stainless steel trowel at 1–2 mm thickness. Two coats are required, with 24 hours drying between coats. Apply the second coat perpendicular to the first to minimise trowel lines. Dampen the trowel blade for a smoother finish.

Coverage: 1.5–2.0 m² per kg per coat. Plan for 2 coats total.

Pot Life: 60 minutes at 20°C. Discard mixed product after this time.

Cure between coats: 24 hours minimum at 20°C, 50% RH. Sand lightly with 120-grit paper between coats and remove all dust before proceeding.

Full cure: 28 days for full structural strength. Sealers may be applied after 48 hours.

Temperature: 10°C–30°C. Protect from frost. Do not apply in direct sunlight or if wind causes rapid drying.

Substrates: Must be applied over cured Semco 2K Primer only. Do not apply over Adhesion Primer for floor applications.

name: Semco Microcement Finish — Ultra Fine (R Series)
tdsContent:
Semco Microcement Finish R Series is the ultra-fine (0–150μm) decorative finish coat that delivers the signature Semco aesthetic. It is pre-pigmented or used in conjunction with Semco pigment concentrates.

Mixing: If using pigment, add Semco Pigment Concentrate to the water before adding powder. Mix water and pigment thoroughly first. Add powder to pigmented water. Water ratio: 26–28% by weight. Mix 3 minutes at low speed. Rest 2 minutes, re-mix briefly.

Application: Apply with a stainless steel trowel in thin, overlapping passes at 0.5–1 mm thickness. Two coats required. Apply the second coat when the first is firm but not fully dry (approximately 4–6 hours at 20°C). Polish the surface using circular motions with a slightly damp trowel to compact and refine the finish.

Coverage: 2.0–2.5 m² per kg per coat. Plan for 2 coats.

Pot Life: 45 minutes at 20°C.

Critical: All pigment batches for a single project must be mixed from the same batch lot. Note the lot number on packaging.

Sanding: After the second coat is fully dry (24 hours), sand lightly with 220-grit. Remove all dust before sealing.

Full cure before sealing: 48 hours minimum at 20°C.

name: Semco 2K Sealer — Gloss
tdsContent:
Semco 2K Sealer Gloss is a two-component water-based polyurethane topcoat providing high abrasion resistance, water resistance, and a high-gloss finish. Suitable for floors and walls.

Mixing: Component A to Component B = 4:1 by volume. Mix thoroughly for 2 minutes. Allow to induct for 5 minutes before application.

Application: Apply 2–3 coats with a short-nap microfibre roller (6mm). Apply in thin, even coats. Allow 6–8 hours between coats at 20°C.

Coverage: 10–12 m² per kg.

Pot Life: 60 minutes at 20°C.

Light foot traffic: 24 hours after final coat. Full service: 7 days.

For floors: minimum 3 coats recommended for residential applications. 4–5 coats for commercial.

Temperature: 15°C–28°C. Do not apply if temperature will drop below 5°C within 24 hours of application.

name: Semco 2K Sealer — Matte
tdsContent:
Semco 2K Sealer Matte is a two-component water-based polyurethane topcoat providing excellent abrasion and stain resistance with a low-sheen matte appearance. Suitable for floors and walls.

Mixing: Component A to Component B = 4:1 by volume. Mix for 2 minutes. Allow 5-minute induction before application.

Application: Apply 2–3 coats with a short-nap microfibre roller. 6–8 hours between coats at 20°C.

Coverage: 10–12 m² per kg.

Pot Life: 60 minutes at 20°C.

Light foot traffic: 24 hours after final coat. Full cure: 7 days.

Note: Matte sheen may vary slightly between coats. Ensure uniform application to avoid sheen inconsistency. Final coat determines overall sheen level.

name: Semco 2K Sealer — Satin
tdsContent:
Semco 2K Sealer Satin provides a mid-sheen satin finish with the same durability and water resistance as the Gloss variant. Most popular finish for residential interiors.

Mixing: Component A to Component B = 4:1 by volume. Mix for 2 minutes. 5-minute induction before use.

Application: 2–3 coats with a 6mm microfibre roller. 6–8 hours between coats.

Coverage: 10–12 m² per kg.

Pot Life: 60 minutes at 20°C.

Light foot traffic: 24 hours. Full cure: 7 days.

name: Semco Surface Filler
tdsContent:
Semco Surface Filler is used to fill tile grout lines, minor surface imperfections, and transitions before priming. It is not a standalone base coat.

Application: Apply with a rubber squeegee or spatula, forcing the filler into grout lines or cracks. Remove excess immediately. Allow to cure 4 hours before sanding flush with the substrate surface. Apply primer after sanding and cleaning.

Coverage varies depending on substrate condition. Typically 3–4 m² per kg for tile grout filling.

Pot Life: 30 minutes at 20°C.
